arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacon patterns in memory or files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "medium"
        false_positives = "Packed .NET assemblies, legitimate update modules"
        remediation = "Whitelist known-good hashes exhibiting this pattern to reduce noise"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 72 00 } // '.rcdr' section often present
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide
        $https_uri = /https://[0-9a-zA-Z\-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}/
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) and filesize < 500KB
}

// EXCLUSION: Whitelist confirmed legitimate Windows update module
$whitelist_hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2"
condition:
    not (hash.sha256(0, filesize) == $whitelist_hash) and all of ($beacon*) and filesize < 500KB
